experiment_data.notes:
**D033 重新解读：Router 判别力接近随机，非"成功"。**

4-seed 汇总（generation-level, ga=8, upsample_minority）：
| Seed | balanced_acc | internal_recall | det_recall |
|------|-------------|-----------------|------------|
| 42   | 59.27%      | 51.52%          | 67.03%     |
| 123  | 57.36%      | 57.58%          | 57.14%     |
| 456  | 57.48%      | 75.76%          | 39.19%     |
| 789  | 58.31%      | 81.82%          | 34.80%     |

balanced_acc 均值 58.1±0.8%（仅比随机高 8pp）。internal_recall 波动（51-82%）完全是阈值效应——更高的 internal_recall 必然伴随更低的 det_recall，判别力不变。

**论文定位**：Router near-random IS the finding → 强化 C1（death avoidance 主导到 router 无法从 episode-level labels 学到其他有效 signal）。不再称"首个非退化 router"或"成功训练"。

原始 generation-level eval: accuracy=65.36%, balanced_acc=59.27%, internal_recall=51.52%, zero logit-generation gap。Eval 脚本: eval_ablation_b_gen.py。
